components.name: Map control

components.css: .ds-map-step { box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 244px; height: 168px; padding: 15px 16px 12px; color: var(--flow-ink, #263d34); background: var(--flow-node, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--flow-rule, #c9d8cd); border-radius: 12px; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-map-step-title { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 9px; border: 0; padding: 0; background: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-map-step-title svg { flex: 0 0 22px; width: 22px; height: 22px; color: #37755a; } .ds-map-step-title strong { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -.015em; font-weight: 600; } .ds-map-step-title:hover strong { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-map-step p { color: var(--flow-muted, #53695b); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.45; margin: 9px 0 0; } .ds-map-step-meta { display: flex; gap: 7px; align-items: center; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 7px; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1; } .ds-map-step-stage { font: 500 11px/1 "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; background: var(--flow-control, #f0f4ee); border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 5px; } .ds-map-step.ds-is-active { border-color: var(--md-accent-fg-color, #17685b); background: var(--flow-control, #f0f4ee); } .ds-map-step-title:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--md-accent-fg-color, #17685b); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
The technical handbook gives long explanations a calm, deliberate reading surface. Forest green anchors the masthead, pale green neutrals separate supporting material, and IBM Plex connects prose, commands and engineering maps with a consistent technical voice. Density comes from useful navigation and structured information, while the article remains the visual center.

This system applies to the documentation in `docs/site`, including the read-only maps built from `scripts/docs`. The product console has its own implementation and is outside this document. The visual direction is settled in `docs/engineering/320-documentation-design.md`; the normative values here come from the shipped styles and MkDocs configuration.
keyCharacteristics: Long-form reading with a bounded measure and clear heading hierarchy.
Forest-green light and dark themes with thin structural rules.
Local IBM Plex Sans and Mono across Portuguese, English and Spanish.
Read-only engineering maps with explicit states and equivalent text.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: Planned and failure paths carry labels and distinct line treatments as well as color. Do not make hue the only explanation of a relationship.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Keep paragraphs and ordinary lists within the established article measure. Let code and maps manage their own overflow without widening the page.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Article containers stay flat. Use a thin rule and a tonal surface to establish grouping; reserve inherited overlay elevation for temporary navigation and search.

dos: **Do** reuse the local IBM Plex fonts and preserve complete Portuguese, English and Spanish interfaces.
**Do** keep article links visibly underlined and all controls reachable with a visible keyboard focus.
**Do** use the dark palette for every custom reading and map surface.
**Do** pair each interactive map with its static SVG, semantic steps and local references.
**Do** respect reduced motion and keep ordinary page scrolling available over maps.
donts: **Don't** introduce marketing hero treatments or decorative imagery into this reading system.
**Don't** use the map card shape to turn ordinary prose and navigation into a wall of cards.
**Don't** encode planned or failure states through color alone.
**Don't** replace local assets with remote font or diagram runtime dependencies.
